args.name: urgent-food-foraging
args.function: Find and collect reachable ripe food suitable for me using actual observations, including checking previously empty plants for real replenishment. Support a bounded emergency search while satiety is below 8 if health and available energy still permit it, rather than treating low satiety alone as a reason to abandon obtaining food.
args.conditions: At tick 138 I have health 100, satiety 19.8, energy about 13.53, no inventory, and position (28.5,34.5). The latest berry search exhausted its area without collecting anything. Multiple remembered food plants were empty when observed. Berries are personally tested safe with nutrition 8. There are no currently visible actors or stocked food sources. Recent northern animal sightings make that direction concerning.
args.inputs: Actual visible and remembered source identities, current observations, personally known food suitability, reachable terrain, and explicit time, travel, energy and health limits.
args.costs: Method and total cost are unknown; observation, movement, gathering and any learning must consume their real time and energy. No food or knowledge should be created merely by this request.
args.effects: A usable emergency-foraging method, or an explanation of the feasible existing actions and limitations. Do not assume stale empty-source records remain current, invent ripe stock, or grant unearned mastery.

candidates.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.
candidates.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
candidates.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

candidates.function: Judge whether an item or source within reach is suitable food for you or a person you see, from probe evidence and your own cited records: identity, nutrition, toxicity and preparation each supported, contradicted or unresolved. inspect observes it with probe; trial runs probe press, wet or heat on your own sample. Nothing is tasted, eaten or fed.
candidates.costs: Study 1 round, no energy; needs probe. inspect: probe observe, 1 round, 0.2 energy, no material. trial (methodRef press, wet or heat; intensity is the press load): probe's trial, 1 round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 unit of your own sample, consumed as loss; heat also takes 0.1 available heat from a source in reach, wet needs water where you stand. A trial needs a cited verified probe record of the same kind, method and load to compare with, since a load, water or heat response measures no nutrition, harm or preparation; otherwise it is refused, naming what is missing. Refusals cost nothing: target not seen now (only remembered or named), out of reach, another person's item, not a material, consumer not you or a person you see, unknown record ids. No surcharge, no refund.
candidates.effects: target: exact id of your item, a loose item or a source in reach. evidenceRefs: up to 6 ids of your records (record key or its evidence id, an eating record by its kind, a heard message id). intendedConsumer: you by default or a person you see; only your own records are used. Identity is supported only by your own eating record of the same kind, never by a name or label; only then are its satiety and health loss cited, and preparation is none for units as you ate them. A trial response that differs from the reference contradicts identity; a match identifies nothing. Without applicable evidence: "safety unresolved; do not consume on this evidence." An event and your record <target>:food-suitability keep the findings, evidence and limits. Nothing is gathered, moved, created, detoxified, certified or rewarded.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

candidates.function: Inspect an established rooted food plant in reach and its growth needs, and loosen soil or clear competing plants by hand only where the growth model has crust, compaction or competition that limits it.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds, no energy; needs probe. inspect: probe's observation of the plant, 1 round, 0.2 energy. prepare (hand loosening where modeled crust or compaction limits the plant, clearing where modeled competition does) would take 3 rounds at 2 energy each and maintain 1 round at 1 energy; this world's soil and plant model has neither condition, so both take 1 round, 0 energy, and change nothing. cancel: 1 round, 0 energy. Refusals cost nothing: target not in view or reach, or not an established rooted food plant that regrows (fungi, fish, seedlings, non-food and non-regrowing plants).
candidates.effects: target: a plant you see. inspect: probe's record (stock, growth, stage, soil) and the plant's growth contract from the existing rule: growth per ripe unit, growth so far, the least rounds to the next unit at the best rate (growth scale x full daylight), the temperature range (none at minGrowth, full at optimalGrowth), moisture need, waterlogging, harvest pressure 1/(1+depletion/20) and what limits it now. The first inspection records a baseline in your patch record (one square unit around the plant, at most 8 records); later ones report the change. prepare/maintain: 'no corrective work indicated', with the reason; quantity (rounds of work) stays unused. cancel: close the record for target, or all without one. Growth runs only through the existing rule, tended or not; harvest only with gather. No water is carried. Nothing is moved, created, refunded or rewarded.

candidates.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
candidates.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
candidates.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

candidates.function: Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
candidates.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The searched related capabilities cover the component actions but not the requested control behavior. bounded-resource-search explicitly excludes sources previously observed empty and stops at satiety <= 8; neither is an argument that can currently be changed. probe can establish fresh local stock, navigate can approach a remembered location, and gather can transfer actual ripe stock, but their availability alone does not implement the requested bounded search. Develop a minimal general extension of the existing search controller through the current-conversation handoff, recording code reuse rather than claiming reinvention. No food, suitability knowledge, successful search or personal mastery is granted by this review.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: bounded resource search with reinspection and emergency modes, applicable to any actor and known resource. Implement by extending and reusing bounded-resource-search (forage:bounded-search-and-collection:1), navigate (base:navigate:1), probe (open-baseline:probe:1; handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1) and gather (base:gather:1). Preserve ordinary mode. Inputs: resource kind, origin, radius, requested quantity, maximum cumulative path, elapsed simulation rounds, cumulative energy spend, minimum remaining energy, minimum health, permitted temperature range, optional excluded directions/areas, and modes ordinary or emergency plus recheck-previously-empty. All bounds must be finite and explicit; reject an invalid plan before work. Reuse existing defaults and limits where unchanged. The emergency option changes only the controller's satiety stop: satiety <= 8 alone does not stop it. It does not suppress hunger, starvation damage, injury, exhaustion, temperature effects, terrain restrictions or death. Require health > 60, no injury in the preceding round, temperature within the existing search tolerance of 10 from 22, and all supplied stricter limits before each step; retain these stops in emergency mode. Energy reserve must cover at least the registered eat cost of 1 energy when searching for food; each movement, inspection and gathering step must still be affordable above that reserve. This is a bounded attempt, not a safety or food guarantee.\\nCandidate handling: visible sources and personally remembered source locations inside the permitted area may be investigated even when their last observation was empty. A past stock record is historical evidence, never current stock. Never consult hidden stock to select routes or promise replenishment. Follow the existing nearest-reachable ordering, with deterministic ties, and track which sources have been inspected during this run. Inspect each empty source at most once per run; do not repeatedly visit it based on elapsed time alone. Further checks require a separately bounded run or new observable evidence of change. Exploration of observed traversable ground remains available under the existing controller's limits; skip excluded or unaffordable candidates rather than silently exceeding limits. Sources created by another person remain excluded. No new pathfinding, remote sensing, growth accelerator or food-safety certification is implied.\\nAn observation must be performed through probe observe on a currently visible subject using its applicable reach rules. A remembered source first supplies only a destination for navigate. Probe costs 1 round and 0.2 energy and records only genuinely observable facts with subject ID, observation tick and event reference. If empty, record that result and continue only if another affordable step remains. If ripe stock is observed, gather only within the source's interaction range: at most the current stock, requested quantity remaining and affordable units. Gathering costs 2 energy per unit and one ordinary gather round; source stock decreases by exactly the units added to inventory. No harvesting from growth counters, negative stock or automatic replenishment. All growth remains governed solely by the existing plant simulation. navigate travels at most 0.8 distance per round and costs actual distance times 2 energy with registered terrain and carried-mass modifiers. Charge real movement already completed if interrupted. Do not add a controller surcharge or invent a study material requirement.\\nFor food, applicability uses only the actor's own evidence for the resource in the relevant preparation state. Lin's berry record at tick 66 supports the personally tested berries with nutrition 8 and toxicity 0; it does not certify tubers or all visually similar plants. assess-food-suitability (food:evidence-qualified-suitability:1) is an optional separately learned dependency for evidence-qualified judgments, not a required new study for collecting the already personally tested resource. Lin's old commons-berry-1-0 observation at tick 15 is not current stock. forest-tuber-1 was observed with stock 0 and has no supplied personal safety evidence; canopy-42 is branches, not food. Neither is a stocked suitable food source. The current energy 13.5338693 and satiety 19.8 do not establish that any route will yield food. The reported northern animal concern can be expressed as an excluded area, not converted into invented hazard locations.\\nPersist run ID, arguments, pending target, visited/empty observations, actual path, elapsed rounds, energy used and quantities gathered. Execute at most one ordinary navigate, probe or gather step per round. Reprice each step against current state before acting; refuse a step that exceeds any limit. Finish on quantity reached, exhaustion of admissible candidates/exploration, or a safety/resource limit, reporting actual quantities including zero and the exact stop reason. Another action pauses the run; paused elapsed world rounds count toward its deadline, but development/review waiting advances no world time. Resume revalidates all limits, evidence and ownership; never resumes an obsolete harvest without checking current reach and stock. Cancel or death terminates future work. Completed movement, observation records and collected units persist subject to ordinary world rules; spent time, energy and harvested source stock are not refunded. Cancellation transfers no items and death follows normal inventory handling, without a special refund or resurrection. There is no ongoing process after termination and no maintenance beyond ordinary costs while running. Eating remains a separate eat action (base:eat:1), consuming an owned unit and 1 energy and applying actual nutrition/toxicity; searching never feeds the actor automatically. Any other participant must communicate and act independently. Established checks, ordering, limits and outcomes must execute in code without repeated model review.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Lin must individually complete one simulation round of study after implementation, with no added study energy or material charge and with ordinary world metabolism; neither this request nor development waiting teaches the capability. Registration, study completion, choosing targets and issuing queries earn no pleasure or satisfaction. The controller adds no reward payout. A real informative inspection, including an empty-source finding that genuinely updates personal evidence, may be considered only by existing experience rules with personal applicability, bounded award/cap, decay/cooldown and functional deduplication against the underlying probe event; search must not award again for the same event. Familiar legitimate practice need not be novel to qualify for existing modest maintenance benefits, but mere repetition is insufficient. No protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions are altered. No mood adjustment reduces basic nutrition; physical comfort remains capped at 10.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable start, movement, inspection, empty-result, collection, pause, resume and terminal events tied to the run and underlying action IDs. Reuse navigate, probe and gather visual metadata rather than inventing duplicate physical effects. Provide reusable metadata fields for operation, phase, actor, visible target, position, event tick, collected quantity and termination reason; render remembered source markers as historical rather than live stock. Empty inspections show an observed-empty outcome, limit stops show stopped or incomplete, and collection success appears only after an actual source-to-inventory transfer. A planned route, study or failed search cannot display food acquisition, restored satiety, replenishment or mastery. Do not expose hidden source stock, concealed hazards or information outside the actor's observations.\"}]}"}
